title: Verify authoritative monetary source is established at transaction creation
gherkin:
Feature: Authoritative Monetary Source Consistency
  Scenario: Establish authoritative monetary source at transaction creation
    Given a transaction is initiated for a customer
    When the transaction is created with a base currency
    Then the authoritative monetary source is recorded and locked
    And the authoritative currency cannot be changed retroactively
    And all subsequent calculations reference this authoritative source
rationale: Establishes that an authoritative monetary source must be defined and immutable at transaction creation time, preventing inconsistencies from retroactive currency changes.
usedContextItems: Monetary source consistency must be maintained across calculation, storage, and user-facing display

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
